summary: Describes a simple mechanism for detecting data plane failures in MPLS Label Switched Paths. It has two parts: the information in an MPLS echo request and echo reply used for fault detection and isolation, and ways to send the reply reliably. It is standards-track and was replaced by RFC 8029.

eli5.summary: Like ping for a label-switched path: send a small hello down the path and see whether an answer comes back.

questions: how to detect mpls data plane failures
